description: Government open data search across 16 national portals in one call: Korea (data.go.kr), Japan, Hong Kong, Australia, UK, Canada, the EU catalog (139,000+ datasets), Germany, Italy, Ireland, Switzerland, Netherlands, Israel and Chile. Query in any language; each match returns organization, update time and download URLs ready for opendata.table. Portals that did not answer are listed. Input: query; optional region, limit, portals. $0.10 per call.
name: hubvibe_opendata_search
title: Search 16 government open-data portals for datasets
